name: E-commerce, Product & Food Image Prompts
body: # E-commerce, products, and food Ten Qwen Image 3.0 prompt recipes. Replace bracketed inputs before generation. All quoted text is exact; no translation is implied unless explicitly requested. Outputs require human review. ## COM-01 — Modular desk lamp hero ```text Create a square catalog photograph of a fictional modular desk lamp. One matte butter-yellow lamp has a cylindrical weighted base, a single hinged arm and a shallow conical shade; place it on an ivory tabletop with a cobalt repair knob beside the base. Use soft light from the upper left and a gentle contact shadow. The only text is "LATCH" on the base and "Keep the light" in the upper-left margin. Preserve plausible joints and one power cord. No certification badges, prices or extra parts. Variables: finish and approved brand text. ``` ## COM-02 — Lunchbox product views ```text Using one authorized product photograph as the geometry reference, create a 16:9 presentation with four equal views of the same rectangular lunchbox: front closed, rear closed, open overhead and latch close-up. Use a pale seamless background and identical soft lighting. Label the views only "Front", "Back", "Inside", and "Latch". Preserve compartment count, seal color and latch placement in every view; invent no dimensions or material claims. Leave visible space between panels. Variables: product reference and translated labels. ``` ## COM-03 — Three tea tins ```text Create a 3:2 packaging concept for three fictional tea tins sharing one cylindrical shape. Arrange them in a straight line, with distinct cream, lavender and sage label bands. Use the shared brand "Field Notes" and the respective names "Morning", "Noon", and "Evening"; add no other text. Photograph on a neutral shelf with consistent highlights and scale. Keep lids, typography alignment and label width identical across all three tins. Do not claim ingredients, origin or health benefits. Variables: approved brand, names and colors. ``` ## COM-04 — Backpack feature board ```text Use an authorized backpack reference and three supplied feature descriptions to create a 3:4 product information image. Place the full backpack on the left; align three detail circles vertically on the right, linked only to the relevant zip, shoulder strap and side pocket. Render exactly [APPROVED FEATURE LABELS] beside their matching circles. Use a pale gray background and controlled studio lighting. Preserve actual construction and colors; no waterproof, capacity or ergonomic claim unless explicitly supplied. Variables: reference, labels and accent color. ``` ## COM-05 — Bread making process ```text Create a 16:9 four-panel image showing one fictional bakery's sourdough workflow: mixing dough, folding dough, scoring a shaped loaf and presenting the baked loaf. Use close documentary photography on the same wooden bench, left-to-right reading order and consistent flour-dusted hands. Label panels "Mix", "Fold", "Score", and "Bake". Keep exactly four panels and distinguish raw dough from baked crust. Do not add cooking temperatures or timing. This is an illustrative process concept, not food-safety instruction. Variables: dough type and approved labels. ``` ## COM-06 — Lunch assortment ```text Create a 16:9 overhead catalog image of four realistic lunch bowls in a two-by-two grid: roasted squash and rice, mushrooms and noodles, lentils and carrots, and tomatoes with couscous. Use identical shallow white bowls, distinct textures, soft daylight and a muted green table. Leave equal gaps and no overlapping utensils. Add no text, calorie counts, dietary guarantees or ingredient labels. Keep plausible portions and avoid repeated food textures. Variables: four supplied recipes, bowl finish and tabletop color. ``` ## COM-07 — Bilingual noodle menu ```text Create a 3:4 menu for fictional café "小巷面馆" with the subtitle "LANE NOODLES". Use ivory paper, charcoal type and three horizontal rows; each row pairs one small realistic bowl photograph on the left with its text on the right. Render exactly "番茄面 · Tomato noodles · 28", "菌菇面 · Mushroom noodles · 32", and "芝麻面 · Sesame noodles · 30". Match red tomato broth, mushroom topping and sesame dressing to their respective rows. No currency symbol, allergens, extra dishes or claims. This is fictional menu copy; retain both languages exactly. ``` ## COM-08 — Room textile comparison ```text Use one authorized room photograph to create a 16:9 two-panel comparison. The left panel reproduces the source; the right changes only the sofa throw and two cushions to [APPROVED COLORS]. Keep windows, walls, furniture positions, camera angle and light unchanged. Label panels "Original" and "Textile concept" in a slim border outside the photographs. Preserve fabric folds and contact shadows; do not repair the room, remove personal belongings or invent extra décor. Variables: source image and colors. ``` ## COM-09 — Refill package instructions ```text Create a 3:4 packaging-use concept with three vertically stacked panels: empty bottle beside refill pouch, pouch nozzle pouring into bottle, and closed bottle next to folded empty pouch. Use the same unbranded amber bottle and ivory pouch in all panels, with clean technical illustration and sage arrows. Render only "Open", "Refill", and "Close". Keep exactly three steps, no liquid spills and no reversed pouring direction. Do not imply food or chemical compatibility. Variables: verified container design and approved instruction labels. ``` ## COM-10 — Bundle contents flat lay ```text Using [APPROVED CONTENTS LIST] and authorized product references, create a square flat lay showing exactly one of each included item in a starter stationery kit. Arrange the notebook centrally and smaller items around it with generous spacing; use warm paper texture and soft overhead light. Add only the title "Inside the kit" and the supplied item names aligned to their objects. Preserve item counts, relative size and colors. Do not add gifts, prices, warranty seals or accessories absent from the list. ``` [Back to the prompt index](./README.md).
description_en: Ten Qwen Image 3.0 recipes for catalog photography, multi-view product boards, packaging concepts and food process shots — built around preserving a reference product's real construction.
description_zh: 十条面向 Qwen Image 3.0 的电商与食品出图配方，涵盖目录级产品图、多视角展示板、包装概念与流程图，核心是保持参考实物的真实构造不被改动。
long_en: The recipes specify studio lighting direction, background, panel counts and the exact labels to render, then lock the parts that must not drift: compartment count, seal color, latch placement, identical lids and label widths across a product family. A recurring negative clause forbids invented dimensions, ingredient, origin, capacity, waterproofing or health claims, and several recipes require you to supply an authorized product photograph as the geometry reference.
long_zh: 每条配方规定棚拍布光方向、背景、分格数量与需精确渲染的标签文字，同时锁定不得漂移的细节：内格数量、密封条颜色、卡扣位置、同系列包装的盖型与标签宽度必须一致。反复出现的否定约束禁止臆造尺寸、成分、产地、容量、防水或健康功效等宣称；其中数条要求你自行提供已获授权的产品照片作为几何参考。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Several recipes assume you supply an authorized product reference image — use only photographs you have the rights to. Written for Qwen Image 3.0; text rendering and reference fidelity differ on other models. The repo is curated by the commercial platform bestimage.ai, though the prompt files carry no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。其中数条预设你会提供「已获授权」的产品参考图——请只使用自己拥有权利的照片。针对 Qwen Image 3.0 撰写，换用其它模型时文字渲染与参考图还原度会有差异。来源仓库由商业平台 bestimage.ai 维护，但提示词文件本身无产品植入。
